notes: Although catalogued as civil works, this PDF holds two forms: Civil Works Bid-Out (pages 1-2, items 1-11) and Goods and Services Bid-Out (pages 3-6, 21 items). They are transcribed as separate tables civilWorks and goodsServices.

Page 2 of the civil works form carries the header "FDP Form 10b - Bid Results on Goods and Services" but its title is "CIVIL WORKS BID-OUT" and it continues the civil works numbering (items 7-11); it is kept in the civilWorks table.

Civil works "Name and Address" column prints the contact person followed by the address; the person is in bidderContact and the address in bidderAddress. Addresses partly run into the next line on the scan (e.g. "Z3-308", "601", "Blk", "Rm" printed at the right of the first line) and are joined in reading order.

Goods and services "Name and Address Of Bidder" column repeats the bidder name in bold before the address; only the address is kept in bidderAddress. The bold name differs slightly from the Winning Bidder column in some rows: "ACE MEDICAL SOLUTIONS, INC.", "LEXSYS TECHNOLOGIES INCORPORATED".
Civil works item 8 reference number is printed "24.-02"; transcribed as printed.

Goods item 24-02-0161 (Dietary Supplement for Malnourished Children of CHO): printed bid amount 122,334.00 against an ABC of 1,124,965.20 (about 11% of ABC); transcribed as printed, possibly a typo in the source.

Signatories on the civil works pages are Vanessa Jeanne A. Dela Serna (BAC Secretariat Head) and Atty. James Allan Sayson (BAC Chairperson); the goods and services pages add Quenie May S. Espinosa (BAC Secretariat Member) and print the chair as "Atty. James Allan C. Sayson, BAC Chairman".

bidderNormalized: a canonical spelling added by the transcriber so the same company ranks as one bidder across documents (case, punctuation and obvious misspellings unified, e.g. variants confirmed by the bidder name repeated in the address column or by an identical contact person/address). The printed name is kept unchanged in bidder.
